query: What's the best budget Android phone in 2024 under $400?
atoms: trustworthiness: Independent display and hardware testing
plausible_answers: Answer A (Pixel 7a Default): Get the Google Pixel 7a — its camera quality, guaranteed multi-year updates, and clean Android experience make it the best overall mid-range Android when discounted to the $350–400 range.

Answer B (Samsung Galaxy A54 for Display): Choose the Samsung Galaxy A54 if display quality is your priority — its AMOLED panel and 4 years of OS updates make it the best balance of screen quality and software longevity.

Answer C (Motorola for Battery): Buy a Motorola G Power if all-day battery life is your main concern — nothing in the sub-$300 range comes close to its battery performance, even at the cost of camera and display quality.
